redfin.remarks: 2917 Durand Drive | Hollywood Hills * * An extraordinary value in the Hollywood Hills—where privacy, architecture and some of Los Angeles' most iconic views come together in one remarkable residence. * * Perched atop a private ridgeline in coveted Beachwood Canyon, 2917 Durand Drive is a striking steel-framed modern home offering a rare sense of seclusion just minutes from the heart of the city. Set on a 9,119 sq ft lot with virtually no immediate neighbors, the property commands sweeping, unobstructed views of the Hollywood Sign, Griffith Observatory, Downtown Los Angeles, Lake Hollywood and the city skyline—with ocean views visible on clear days. Approximately 3000 sq ft of dramatic living space is designed around the view. Soaring ceilings, polished concrete floors with radiant heat, expansive walls of glass and retractable corner doors create effortless indoor-outdoor living and the sensation of floating above Los Angeles. At the center of the outdoor experience is a spectacular infinity-edge pool seemingly suspended over the city below—an unforgettable setting for entertaining, sunset cocktails or simply watching Los Angeles transform from daylight to a sea of lights. The multi-level floor plan combines open entertaining spaces with private retreats, while views unfold from virtually every level. A dedicated gym or executive office provides flexible additional space, and an elevator from the street-level garage adds convenience rarely found in a hillside residence. The primary suite is a private escape of its own, opening directly to the skyline and featuring a spa-inspired bath with steam shower, Japanese soaking tub and glass-enclosed shower—all surrounded by extraordinary views. Built new in 2012 and offered fully furnished with curated designer interiors, this is a true turnkey opportunity for a buyer seeking something increasingly difficult to find in the Hollywood Hills: * * architectural significance, genuine privacy, dramatic views, a pool and effortless luxury in one complete property. * * Whether envisioned as a sophisticated primary residence, Los Angeles pied-à-terre, creative retreat or trophy property, 2917 Durand Drive delivers an experience that photographs cannot fully capture. * * Now offered at $3,995,000. Private showings by appointment. * *
